title: Apple's App Store Ads To Generate $2 Bln In Revenues By 2020
text: Apple's App Store Ads To Generate $2 Bln In Revenues By 2020 CUPERTINO (dpa-AFX) - Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) App Store ads could generate $2 billion in revenues by 2020, CNBC reports.Bernstein Analysts Toni Sacconaghi expects Apple's Search Ad business to generate over $500 million in revenue in 2018 and quadruple it to $2 billion by 2020.According to the report, Sacconaghi said his estimate that Apple could reach $2 billion in Search Ad revenue by 2020 was 'conservative.' This revenue growth in ad business will help the tech giant to offset slowing iPhone sales. Apple has been investing a lot to improve its services businesses like iCloud and Apple Music.Apple is likely to meet or exceed its goal of doubling its Services revenue by the end of 2020 to $49 billion.Copyright RTT News/dpa-AFX
